svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Containers and Docker, slide 3. Virtual machines vs containers
svg.desc: Virtual machines are houses: each brings its own guest OS and kernel on a hypervisor, weighs GBs and boots in minutes. Containers are apartments: they share the host's one kernel through Docker, weigh MBs and start in under a second.
svg.text: A VM is a house with its own OS and kernel. Containers are apartments sharing one kernel.
each VM carries a whole OS
